newsitem.title: USA: Intl Paper to raise return on investment.
newsitem.headline: Intl Paper to raise return on investment.

text.p: International Paper said Wednesday its primary objective for 1997 will be to increase its return on investment.
Company Chief Executive John Dillon said the financial performance must improve.
Dillon said the company's long-term goal is a 12-percent average return on investment over the life of a business cycle.

Dillon also said the company was not planning any pulp or paper projects that would add capacity. He said working capital as a percent of sales would be cut and the company wil reduce both debt and those asset holdings that no longer meet its long-term investment goals.
